segments.title: Chương 161: 0161【Hiện Tượng Super Girl】
segments.content:
June 24th, Friday.

ByteDance's recruitment had ended, but most of the new employees had yet to start work. The newly renovated office space needed a few days to air out.

A few of the more outstanding interviewees, if not hired by ByteDance, would be asked if they were willing to go to Game Science.

Because Game Science was also expanding.

Just last month, Game Science had hired a batch of programmers responsible for developing Doudizhu, Mahjong, and other chess and card games.

QQ Youying dozed off for a bit. After a while, she felt Tsunade poke her in the waist with a finger and woke up with a start, only to find that everyone had already finished watching.

Now, hehe, Zhu Houzhao had no choice but to start using his special powers. Since you all refuse to cooperate, I can only force the issue with an imperial edict.

The title of number one in the world, after the mysterious disappearance of the previous generation's martial arts leader Liu Zongyuan, had been claimed by the rising star Wei Lingjiang, whose kung fu was ridiculously high.

On this day, Chen Dangxin, who had been sweeping through the south, was stopped by an unknown young spear wielder, bringing his southward march to a halt. Chen Dangxin's previous accomplishments seemed to have been a mere prelude for this young man. The name Cao Zhenglei resounded throughout the nation.

A flickering golden flame, which seemed ready to extinguish at any moment, flew unhurriedly towards the descending warhammer and finally collided with the earth-shattering weapon.

Zhan Feng's heart sank. "It's about time," he thought to himself. He abruptly stopped, then shot a pink ray of light at Wang Sheng, who was on his left and trying to overtake him.

Xiao Yu turned and walked back to where Boulos had fallen. Rose, Jack, and John looked at Xiao Yu in shock, momentarily forgetting to greet him.

Discovering his right hand was useless, the scattered elf immediately tried to pass the injection gun to his left hand, but he just couldn't complete such a simple action.

Of course, a centipede dies but never falls down. Although Baishui City had declined, it was still garrisoned by branch factions of the seven great sects. The reason for this was the Wuyou Ravine to the south of Baishui City.

Of course, there was no shortage of overconfident ones among them. Unable to break through the light barrier, they were sent flying, spitting blood, and made a sorry exit amidst the ridicule of the crowd.

Many years later, when she looked back on the love and hate entangled between her and Shen Yu, many past events had become blurry shadows. Yet, she remembered what happened at this moment, Shen Yu's expression and his words, with exceptional, inexplicable clarity.

First, he went to the Class Change Guild and handed Hou Xue's letter to Hou Lan. He didn't receive any reward but was praised by Instructor Hou Lan. Then he went to the consignment market and put up all the equipment for sale: the items dropped by the God Clan in his bag and the ones he had replaced, totaling more than 70 pieces.

Huo Qingqing felt a little uncomfortable seeing this scene. She had been eagerly looking forward to Lü Xiang'er marrying into the General's manor. With something like this happening, even Huo Qingqing wouldn't be happy if she were Lü Xiang'er. However, for her brother's sake, Huo Qingqing still had to take responsibility for consoling Lü Xiang'er.

He retracted his ability and looked at Priest Qingyou with a complicated gaze. The Wood God gave them power, but made it difficult for them to reproduce on their own.

The trees brought back were all fully grown. The ripe fruits on them had been picked, leaving only some unripe ones hanging from the branches, which hadn't fallen off despite all the jostling.

"No." Huo Qingsong desperately wanted to pull the person before him into his arms, but thinking of how she had hidden things from him, he hardened his heart, turned his head to one side, and gently stroked the long spear on the rack.

"How can you be such a scoundrel?" Wu Ruoshi seemed a little angry, but Chen Langya still didn't let go.

There was no point in saying more; Chu Xiu had already rejected him. She would rather stay out of gratitude and seek Shen Yu's protection than leave.

His older cousin, Li Meirong, was looking at a sample of a genealogy book. Apparently, the organizing committee of the local clan association was seeking their opinion.

"Pack it up, take them all away!" Li Hong waved her hand, and everyone got into the cars, escorting three criminal suspects and one corpse to Yincheng. The siren was placed on the car roof, and it wailed as they sped all the way towards Yincheng.

Lao Dao Bazi's car was stopped by two soldiers in black bodysuits holding firearms as soon as it approached the building.

This was no boast. In the army, his marksmanship was superb. After retiring, he took up archery for fun, playing with both Qing heavy bows and English longbows, and even practiced mounted archery.

After all, Du En felt it was a bit unfair that James could be co-named for this year's Rookie of the Year, let alone Anthony.

Bai Ran's face was even paler, almost transparent. Enraged to the extreme, she clenched her hands, and her body couldn't help but tremble.

Everyone dispersed. Fu Hanjiang also got into his car and headed for Silver Beach. Leaning back against the seat, he was equally exhausted.

The incomparably brave Xiang Army scaled the city walls again and again, only to be pushed back by the Taiping Army time and time again.

There were eight sets of costumes and makeup for the character design. Each set required a poster to be shot, so there was much to be done.

Moreover, Hatake Sakumo wasn't just doing this to get Li Cheye to accept red envelopes. The most crucial part was to have him recognize people, essentially sharing some of his own network with Li Cheye.

"Minato, this is the excuse Li Cheye left for us. We can't use it." Jiraiya said slowly, "He said things within his capabilities, not everything. There's a lot of room for interpretation in that."

"Insolence! Did I say you could leave?" How could Wen Qian let her leave just like that? Anxiously, he lost his calm and composure, roaring, "Since you look down on it, then put it down! No one is forcing you to take it!"

Han Shenyan ran along the street, enjoying the cool of the evening breeze. His usual route was to run past three intersections, circle the central garden plaza once, and then run back.

"Mom, the morning air is fresh. You should come out for walks more often when you're free. It's not good to be cooped up in the house all day," Shen Yan said in a gentle voice.

The once-dim Yanqi Commune, with only a few faint oil lamps, now had electricity in every household.

"Baby, I haven't seen you for a few days. Why do I feel like you've gotten paler?" Hu Gangqiang asked curiously, looking at Ding Baona's skin.

Carolyn's body had just recovered, but the aftereffects left her temporarily unable to walk, so she could only lie in bed.

It wasn't until the faint light of dawn that she weakly opened her eyes. Gazing at the sunlight refracting through the cracks, her heart filled with immense regret.

She said, "That day, Third Aunt swore to the heavens that if she ever harmed me behind my back, she'd be bitten by a dog when she went out, choke to death while eating, and die a horrible death."

By the time the other party reacted, Yin Shaojie's car had already disappeared from their sight.

She was wearing a style popular at the time, full of period detail. Her smile was clear and pure, innocent and beautiful.

Shen Yanxiao stayed on the ship for three days, witnessing her group of friends and family bully and berate the real Ming Ye every day, and conveniently collected a lot of good things from them.
